fields.FIR_Description: On 2026-06-02 at about 16:50, it was reported that the complainant found the pocket emptied of cash (about Rs. 3,000) after boarding a crowded bus near Sevvanthi Colony Bus Stand Area in Vellore. Indhu Sri approached Vellore Town PS to report the matter and can be reached on 9000000243. The complainant alleged that Sanjay Anand may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000477. No independent witness was identified at the time of registration. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00344, as the mobile number 9000000477 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Reported theft occurred while the victim was boarding a bus.
fields.Keywords: pickpocketing, wallet, afternoon, bus stand, CCTV, suspect, mobile number
